title: Smoke Alarm Installation quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and install seven new Australian Standards compliant interconnected photoelectric smoke alarms in a two-story, four-bedroom dwelling in Ryde, NSW. This includes removing seven existing outdated ionisation smoke alarms. Four new alarms will be hardwired with ten-year lithium battery backups, requiring approximately twenty-five linear metres of interconnect cable run through ceiling spaces. The remaining three alarms will be wireless interconnected units with ten-year lithium battery backups, strategically placed on the upper floor. All new alarms will be mounted with appropriate bases and tested for full functionality and compliance. A final compliance certificate will be issued upon completion.
workingDetail: Interconnected photoelectric smoke alarms, Mounting bases, Interconnect cable (if hardwired), Wireless interconnect module (if applicable)
